ios.desc:
Meet the smallest enemies in the history of games.
They're only one pixel big.
They're "one-dot enemies"!

Tap them to kill them!
Kill the enemy, kill your time!

quotes.text:
I'm not sure robick (https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/robick/id417016186?mt=8) qualifies, it might deserve a look.

Games which probably qualify:

* One Dot Enemy: https://itunes.apple.com/en/app/one-dot-enemies/id306930506?mt=8

* Passage: https://itunes.apple.com/en/app/passage/id300702040?mt=8

* Uzu (iPad only) and Little Uzu: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/uzu-generative-design-playground/id376551723?mt=8 and

* Kometen: https://itunes.apple.com/en/app/kometen/id371244586?mt=8

* nobynobyboy: https://itunes.apple.com/en/app/noby-noby-boy/id355479163?mt=8

* Kura Kura Maze: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/kurakuramaze/id447017018?mt=8

Ridiculous Fishing may not be weird enough to qualify
quotes.story_title: Show HN: Weird iOS, a list of the weirdest, most artful or unexpected apps
